name: Ravenous
source:
It's been a long time, since you have had any contact with your mother and sister. After a decade of separation, you have graduated from high school, and are moving to the picturesque town of Hollowbrook, to be reunited.

You have a lot of questions about the past, and a lot to learn about the present. With your sister Erica's help, you'll uncover the mysteries that subtly shroud the town of Hollowbrook, meet a cast of quirky characters, and find answers to some of your own personal questions along the way.

But beware... Something sinister lurks...

Welcome..to Hollowbrook.

[From F95Zone]
translation:
你已經很久沒和母親、妹妹聯絡了。分開10年後，你高中畢業，搬到風景如畫的Hollowbrook鎮與她們團聚。

過去有許多疑問，眼前也有許多事情等待你去了解。在妹妹Erica的幫助下，你會揭開Hollowbrook鎮平靜表象下的謎團，結識一群古怪的人物，也會逐漸找到一些關於自己的答案。

不過要小心……有邪惡的東西潛伏著……

歡迎……來到Hollowbrook。

[來源：F95Zone]
